newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Chrysler bid higher.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Chrysler bid higher.

text.p: Shares of Chrysler Corp were bid higher ahead of the open Monday after the company reported much stronger than expected third quarter earnings.

Traders said that Chrysler was bid at 33 after having closed at 31-1/4 on the NYSE on Friday. The company reported third quarter earnings per share of $0.93 compared to $0.45 and well above the First Call estimate of $0.71.
Thrifty Payless Inc was bid at 22 after closing at 18-3/8 on Friday, traders said. Rite Aid Corp said this morning it would acquire Thrifty in a swap of 0.65 Rite Aid share for each Thrifty share.
Intel Corp was bid at 105-3/4 after having closed at 105-3/8. The company is expected to report third quarter earnings after the close of trading today.
Novellus Systems Inc was bid at 46, up from Friday's close at 45-5/8.
